data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous topicals & wound care_

**Class:** Ornithine decarboxylase inhibitor

## Mechanism of action
- Irreversibly inhibits ornithine decarboxylase in hair follicle cells → slows hair growth (does not remove hair)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Facial hirsutism in women (with laser or other hair removal)
- Systemic eflornithine: African trypanosomiasis

## Dose & formulations
- Twice daily (at least 8 h apart); effect in 6–8 weeks; hair regrows within 8 weeks of stopping

## Adverse effects
- Acne, pseudofolliculitis, burning, stinging

## Contraindications
- Under 12 years

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data — avoid.

## Viva points
- ODC inhibitor; slows facial hair growth; combine with laser

_Sources: Khopkar ch.28 (Eflornithine); Wolverton 4e ch.57. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
